caveats: Ten starters total 145.18 expected points -- above the typical 100-140 band, but driven by a fully healthy lineup plus Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 23.76-if-he-plays projection (SEA vs SF, Bosa Out). The last two briefings totalled 136.29 (10/7) and 143.52 (10/5), so this reads as a strong, healthy week rather than a broken pipeline.

Stafford (17.95) over bench Shough (17.59) at QB is the same kind of thin, sub-1-point edge -- held for the same reason, and matches the lineup the owner already set on 10/8.

Bucky Irving's Thursday game is already final (31.5 actual points under this league's rules, on 165 rush yards plus a rushing and a receiving TD) -- shown in the table with his pre-game projection for consistency with every other row; nothing left to decide for that slot.
Jaxson Dart remains on IR (season-ending knee) and was not evaluated for the lineup.

Week 8 is a second, larger bye cluster worth planning around now, even though it's outside this run's two-week window: Zvada, Skattebo, Likely and IR'd Dart are all NYG, and bench QB Shough (NO) byes the same week.

# Week 5 Start/Sit Briefing — Saturday, 2026-10-10

**Final call before the Sunday 1:00pm ET lock.** Three trades landed since Wednesday's briefing (10/8: Golden for LaPorta, Dicker for Zvada, Eagles D/ST for Jaguars D/ST), and Friday's practice reports are in for every team on this roster.

## Source and freshness

The committed Week 5 fixture (generated 2026-10-06T16:07:10Z, FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries) still supplies every conditional projection below, unchanged. But rather than trust its Monday-morning P(play) values on a Saturday/final-call run, I refit `AvailabilityModel` on 2019-2025 nflreadpy data (54,599 player-weeks, held-out AUC 0.823) and scored every rostered player against `load_injuries(2026)` Week 5, which now covers 30 of 32 teams -- only CAR and KC haven't filed, and both are on a Week 5 bye, so coverage is effectively complete. `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` confirms Week 5.

**The one number that moved:** Tee Higgins (Questionable, groin) filed Full Participation in practice. That lifts his fitted P(play) from the fixture's stale 0.884 to 0.934, and his expected points from 13.66 to 14.43. Every other rostered player carries no designation and Full Participation (or no injury-report row at all, which the model reads the same way) -- P(play) moved by at most 0.03 for everyone else.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs BUF (Mon) | 17.95 | 96.6% | 18.59 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @PIT | 17.88 | 97.1% | 18.41 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @DAL -- final (Thu) | 13.73 | 94.5% | 14.54 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs SF | 23.31 | 98.1% | 23.76 |
| WR | Drake London | vs BAL | 16.40 | 96.4% | 17.02 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | @ARI | 12.60 | 94.1% | 13.39 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @ARI | 11.31 | 96.4% | 11.74 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins (Q) | @MIA | 14.43 | 93.4% | 15.45 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | @WAS | 8.10 | 98.4% | 8.22 |
| DEF | Jaguars D/ST | vs PHI (London) | 9.47 | 100% | 9.47 |
| **Total** | | | **145.18** | | |

Bench: Tyler Shough (17.59 exp, QB), Isaiah Likely (12.05, TE), Cam Skattebo (11.78, RB), TreVeyon Henderson (7.64, RB), Jalen Coker (bye, WR). IR: Jaxson Dart (season-ending knee).

Bucky Irving's Thursday game at Dallas is already final -- 165 rush yards, a rushing TD and a receiving TD, 31.5 actual points under this league's scoring, in a 24-16 Tampa Bay win. The table shows his pre-game projection for consistency; nothing left to decide there.

## Changes since Wednesday

**Three trades, plus the lineup reset the owner already made on 10/8:**

- **Sam LaPorta in at TE, over Isaiah Likely** (traded Matthew Golden for LaPorta) -- 12.60 vs 12.05 expected, a real if modest edge.
- **Dominic Zvada in at K** (traded Cameron Dicker for Zvada) -- 8.10 expected vs Dicker's 7.69 last week.
- **Jaguars D/ST in at DEF** (traded away the Eagles D/ST) -- 9.47 expected vs the Eagles' 4.15 last week, and the Jacksonville matchup has only improved since: Philadelphia is now missing both Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith.
- **Stafford back in at QB over Shough**, and **Irving into the second RB slot with Jameson Williams taking the vacated FLEX spot** -- both set by the owner the evening of the trades. The fresh model agrees with both, though the Stafford/Shough edge (+0.36) is thin enough that it isn't a confident call either way.

## Watch list

- **Tee Higgins** -- Questionable (groin), Full Participation Friday. That combination plays at a high rate historically, and the fitted model has him at 93.4%. Worth a last glance at Sunday's inactive list (~11:30am ET) before locking him in, but there's nothing here that should change the start call.
- **Week 6 bye collision** -- Higgins (CIN) and both LaPorta and Jameson Williams (DET) all bye the same week. That's the starting TE and both current FLEX bodies gone at once, with only Coker (WR) and Likely (TE) left on the bench to absorb three vacated spots -- meaning zero bench depth left over once Likely slides into TE. Get a waiver claim in before Week 6's deadline.

## Opponent notes

- **BAL's Lamar Jackson is Out (ankle)** for tonight's game against Atlanta (London) -- a backup-QB start for Baltimore usually means a more conservative, run-first plan, a mild tailwind for Atlanta's own offensive snaps.
- **SF's Nick Bosa is Out (knee)** against Seattle (Smith-Njigba) -- one fewer elite pass rusher is good news for the whole Seahawks passing game.
- **Philadelphia is missing both Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith (both hamstring, Out)** against the Jaguars D/ST -- already this roster's best matchup (PHI's 17.0 implied team total), and probably still undersold, since neither absence existed when Monday's fixture was built.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 6:** Tee Higgins (CIN), Sam LaPorta (DET), Jameson Williams (DET) -- three starting-caliber bodies at once. Flagged above under Watch list; needs action before this week is out.
- **Week 7:** Jaguars D/ST (JAX) -- only rostered DEF, will need a one-week streaming add.
- *(Outside the two-week window, but worth planning for now: Week 8 byes Zvada, Skattebo, Likely and IR'd Dart, all NYG, plus bench QB Shough's NO bye the same week -- a second, larger roster crunch coming right behind this one.)*
